cemc-fryer-2016-04a.prompt:
A BINGO card has twenty-five different integers arranged into five rows and five columns labeled B, I, N, G, and O such that:

- The middle integer is always 0.
- Integers in column B are between 1 and 15 inclusive.
- Integers in column I are between 16 and 30 inclusive.
- Integers in column N are between 31 and 45 inclusive (other than the middle integer being 0).
- Integers in column G are between 46 and 60 inclusive.
- Integers in column O are between 61 and 75 inclusive.

Here is an example of a BINGO card.

| B | I | N | G | O |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 24 | 36 | 48 | 61 |
| 2 | 29 | 31 | 53 | 64 |
| 11 | 18 | 0 | 60 | 68 |
| 15 | 20 | 44 | 51 | 69 |
| 3 | 26 | 42 | 47 | 70 |

(a) What is the smallest possible sum of the numbers in a row on a BINGO card?
